page: Microsoft Azure E48ds_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the EDSv5 family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz, with 24 physical cores and hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 1843 GB SSD, and the server is premium storage capable.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance in memory-intensive and data-handling operations. The server achieves strong ratings in uncached large-block memory read bandwidth at 260.21 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 127.25 GB/sec, alongside a strong PassMark memory score of 2844.62. Database operations are also strong, registering 22997.62 on PassMark. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance benchmarks, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, fall within the average range.

While the server demonstrates strong capabilities in static web serving throughput at 48.57 GB/sec and image processing, it exhibits performance limitations in large-scale machine learning tasks. Specifically, LLM inference text generation using a large 70B model is poor, yielding only 2.33 tokens per second. Given the high memory density, dedicated CPU allocation, and local SSD storage, this server is suited for memory-intensive databases, enterprise applications, and data processing workloads, rather than large-scale LLM text generation.
